Together, these signals led the model to conclude that the likelihood of passing the bar was too low. To improve your chances if you reapply, focus on the root causes: seek structured academic support, strengthen your study techniques, and consider bar-preparation programs. Showing measurable improvement in your academic performance would be the most direct way to address the concern behind this denial.
